scene.head: with_body
scene.placeText: a winter fair on the vast snowy cobbled square of her world's red-brick capital at dusk — wooden stalls hung with golden lanterns, shelves of painted nesting dolls in scarlet, gold and cobalt, the long red-brick wall with its swallowtail battlements and a tall tent-roofed tower banded in green and white tiles behind, snow drifting down
scene.ownProp: the smallest doll of a painted wooden nesting set in scarlet and gold, with a fine paintbrush
scene.outfit: a fairy-tale doll-painter look fitted to her body — a sleeveless scarlet brocade sarafan bodice laced at the front over a short full skirt embroidered in gold flowers and berries, a black wool shawl printed with big crimson roses knotted low on her hips, a small scarlet kokoshnik of pearls and gold thread with long ribbons, and red leather heeled boots
scene.scene: she is the nesting-doll painter of the winter fair, leaning over her stall counter and painting a last red rose onto the smallest doll with a fine brush, a row of finished dolls glowing faintly behind her

prompt:
